description: Defines classes and enums for RTP packet handling, including audio, video, subpicture, and control packets, with methods for setting packet parameters and packing data.

classes.name: TRTPPacket
classes.description: Base class for RTP packets, providing common properties and methods for packet handling.

classes.name: TRTPAudioPacket
classes.description: Derived class for audio RTP packets, with specific flags and data handling.

classes.name: TRTPControlPacket
classes.description: Derived class for control RTP packets, with command ID handling.

methods.name: setSeqNumber
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the RTP packet.

methods.name: getSeqNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence number of the RTP packet.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the packet data into the buffer.

methods.name: setCommandID
methods.description: Sets the command ID for control packets.
